run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-15T13:50:25Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The frontend RequestErrorRate alert is explained by the product-catalog workload being broken by a configuration rollout at 2026-11-15T13:48:34Z. Deployment product-catalog (namespace otel-demo) now carries container command ["invalid-command"] on the same image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog; a new ReplicaSet product-catalog-fcf7564cf (deployment revision 2) was created at 13:48:34Z, the previous ReplicaSet product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc (revision 1) was scaled 1→0 at 13:48:43Z, and the resulting pod product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l cannot start: last termination reason StartError, exit code 128, message 'exec: "invalid-command": executable file not found in $PATH', currently CrashLoopBackOff with 5 restarts. Deployment Available=False (MinimumReplicasUnavailable), and the product-catalog Service Endpoints object has no addresses. Product-catalog server-span rate falls from ~10.5/s to 0 while frontend error-span share rises from 0% (13:45:25Z evaluation) to 4.15% (13:50:25Z) and 57.7% (13:55:25Z). Frontend's error spans are concentrated on dependency paths to product-catalog: grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct (2451.2), GET /api/products/{productId} (2451.2), GET /api/recommendations + grpc.oteldemo.RecommendationService/ListRecommendations (468.27 each), POST /api/checkout + grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (312.7 each), while its AdService and CartService client spans show zero errors. Recommendation's and checkout's own error spans are on their ProductCatalog client calls, so their errors are propagated, not independent. frontend pod and deployment are themselves healthy (1/1 ready, 0 restarts), so the failure is dependency-driven. fraud-detection shows one prior OOMKilled restart but zero error spans and no failed operation linked to this alert; flagd EventStream errors are negligible and present before the rollout. Span-level error text for the incident window is unavailable because Jaeger's retained data ends at 13:33:52Z, and change_history is not integrated, so the actor/record of the deployment change is not verifiable here.

claims.text: Frontend error-span share (spans with status_code=STATUS_CODE_ERROR over all frontend spans, 5m rate) was 0 % at the 13:35:25Z, 13:40:25Z and 13:45:25Z evaluations, then 4.148 % at 13:50:25Z and 57.724 % at 13:55:25Z. The alert's start time 13:50:25Z coincides with the first non-zero reading.

Over the whole query window (12:50:25Z–14:00:07Z) frontend's error spans are: GET (server) 3118.75, GET /api/products/{productId} 2451.2, grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 2451.2, GET /api/recommendations 468.27, grpc.oteldemo.RecommendationService/ListRecommendations 468.27, POST /api/checkout 312.69, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 312.79, POST 312.69, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout 312.79, executing api route (pages) /api/products/[productId] 2451.2, executing api route (pages) /api/recommendations 468.27, tcp.connect 17.32. Zero error spans are recorded for grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem, GET /api/cart and POST /api/cart.

Deployment otel-demo/product-catalog is configured with container command ["invalid-command"] on image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog, observedGeneration 4, replicas 1 with unavailableReplicas 1 and condition Available=False reason MinimumReplicasUnavailable (lastUpdateTime 2026-11-15T13:48:51Z). By contrast deployment otel-demo/frontend has command null, readyReplicas 1, availableReplicas 1 and Available=True.

Pod product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l (owner ReplicaSet product-catalog-fcf7564cf, startTime 2026-11-15T13:48:51Z) is Running but not ready (Ready=False, ContainersNotReady 'containers with unready status: [product-catalog]'), restartCount 5, container state waiting reason CrashLoopBackOff ('back-off 2m40s restarting failed container'), and lastState terminated reason StartError, exitCode 128, message 'failed to create containerd task: ... exec: "invalid-command": executable file not found in $PATH', finishedAt 2026-11-15T13:52:04Z.

Kubernetes events tie the failure to the rollout: Deployment product-catalog 'Scaled up replica set product-catalog-fcf7564cf from 0 to 1' at 13:48:51Z and 'Scaled down replica set product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc from 1 to 0' at 13:48:43Z; ReplicaSet product-catalog-fcf7564cf SuccessfulCreate pod -2fvnx at 13:48:34Z and -vjj7l at 13:48:51Z; Pod events Failed (count 6 on -vjj7l, first 13:48:39Z on -2fvnx, last 13:52:04Z) with the exact message 'exec: "invalid-command": executable file not found in $PATH', and BackOff 'Back-off restarting failed container product-catalog' count 25 on -vjj7l. These are the only Warning events in namespace otel-demo in the window.

Two ReplicaSets belong to deployment product-catalog: product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc (deployment.kubernetes.io/revision=1, created 13:18:33Z, now replicas 0) and product-catalog-fcf7564cf (revision=2, created 2026-11-15T13:48:34Z, replicas 1, readyReplicas absent). Both carry the identical image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog, i.e. the second rollout changed configuration, not the image.

Product-catalog server-span rate (sum of rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="product-catalog"}[5m])) is 10.24/s at the 13:35:25Z evaluation, 10.90/s at 13:40:25Z, 10.50/s at 13:45:25Z, 8.54/s at 13:50:25Z and 0 at 13:55:25Z — product-catalog stopped serving spans in the same interval in which frontend errors appeared.

Service endpoints in namespace otel-demo: product-catalog has NO endpoint addresses (only port 8080 listed), whereas ad, cart, checkout, currency, email, flagd, frontend, frontend-proxy, image-provider, kafka, load-generator, otel-collector, payment, postgresql, quote, recommendation, shipping and valkey-cart all have addresses. With the only product-catalog pod unready, callers have no backend to reach.

Recommendation and checkout error spans are their calls to product-catalog, over the whole window: service recommendation spans /oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/ListProducts 471.47 errors, internal get_product_list 471.47 errors and /flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream 3.06 errors; service checkout spans oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 292.27 errors and oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 292.27 errors.

frontend-proxy's own error-span share rises with frontend's: 0.0183 % at 13:45:25Z, 12.841 % at 13:50:25Z, 56.029 % at 13:55:25Z; over the window its error spans are ingress 3473.32 and router frontend egress 3460.08, i.e. requests enter the proxy successfully and fail while being served by frontend.

Frontend itself was up and not the failing component: pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-9f6l5 is Running, container ready=true, restartCount 0 (startTime 2026-11-15T13:18:34Z), and deployment frontend reports availableReplicas 1, readyReplicas 1, updatedReplicas 1, Available=True. Its own error spans are confined to product/recommendation/checkout dependency operations, with 0 errors on its AdService and CartService client calls.

Pre-rollout baseline was healthy in traces: a sample captured up to 13:33:52Z shows frontend GET/POST spans with http.status_code=200 (including GET /api/products/{productId} 200 and POST /api/checkout 200), frontend grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct with rpc.grpc.status_code=0, and product-catalog server spans oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct with rpc.grpc.status_code=0. This argues the product-catalog path worked before the 13:48 change rather than frontend being configured wrongly.

flagd EventStream errors are negligible and predate the outage (ad 0.0037/s at 13:45:25Z and 0 at 13:55:25Z; recommendation 0.0037/s at 13:35:25Z, 13:45:25Z and 0.0037/s at 13:55:25Z; fraud-detection 0 throughout), so they do not explain the frontend error rate.

Primary cause: a configuration-only rollout of otel-demo/product-catalog at 2026-11-15T13:48:34Z introduced container command ["invalid-command"], so every new product-catalog container fails at exec (StartError, exit 128), the pod sits in CrashLoopBackOff, the Service has no endpoints, and frontend's product/recommendation/checkout request paths return errors — which is what RequestErrorRate for service frontend measures at 13:50:25Z. The chain from deployment → ReplicaSet revision 2 → failing pod → empty Service endpoints → frontend/recommendation/checkout error spans is observed step by step; the only unobserved link is the direct gRPC status text, because Jaeger holds no spans after 13:33:52Z.

Rejected: frontend's own configuration or crash caused the error rate. frontend pod is ready with 0 restarts, deployment frontend is Available with 1/1 ready and unchanged command, and its error spans are only on outbound product-catalog/recommendation/checkout operations while its AdService and CartService calls show zero errors.

Rejected: recommendation service is an independent cause. Its pod recommendation-5f45f75855-xrpch is ready with 0 restarts, and its error spans are exactly its client call /oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/ListProducts plus the derived internal get_product_list span — i.e. propagation of product-catalog being unreachable, not a fault of its own.

Rejected: checkout service is an independent cause. Its error spans are oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct (292.27 each), and its pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-8fzjm is ready with 0 restarts — the failures are its product-catalog calls.

Rejected as the cause of this alert: fraud-detection. Its single pod fraud-detection-9fb7d885b-8bpr4 is currently ready (restartCount 1, lastState terminated reason OOMKilled, exitCode 137) and its error-span counts are 0 over the window (flagd EventStream 0, ResolveInt 0); checkout's failures are on ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, not on a fraud-detection call. The OOM restart is a separate change whose timing is not observable here and is not tied to the frontend error rate.

product-catalog's own spans carry only STATUS_CODE_UNSET (oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 12850.98 and oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/ListProducts 1101.40 over the window), i.e. the workload recorded no ERROR-status spans itself; its outage is visible as absence of traffic (rate 0 after ~13:48) and as failed callers, not as its own error status.

Revert the product-catalog container command to the image default (remove command: ["invalid-command"] for container product-catalog in deployment otel-demo/product-catalog, i.e. restore the revision-1 pod template), then confirm the new pod reaches ready with 0 restarts, that the product-catalog Endpoints object repopulates, and that frontend error-span share returns to its pre-13:48 baseline of ~0 %.

gaps: change_history integration is not available in this Run, so who/what applied the product-catalog deployment change at 2026-11-15T13:48:34Z and the full spec diff of deployment revision 2 could not be verified; the misconfiguration is observed as current object state plus events, not as a change record.

Jaeger's retained data ends at 2026-11-15T13:33:52Z (data_as_of of the only successful trace sample); traces_search and traces_search_by_tags for frontend and recommendation in 13:45Z–14:00:07Z returned no traces, so the exact gRPC status text (e.g. Unavailable/connection refused) on the failing calls during the incident is unknown.

Application logs could not be used: fetch_pod_logs for frontend-675fd7b5c5-9f6l5 returned 0 lines in 13:40Z–14:00:07Z (current instance read but empty, previous instance not found), and for product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l the current instance produced 0 lines and the previous instance was unavailable — the container fails during init, so no application log exists for the failed runs, and frontend's runtime error text is unretrieved.

The metric behind the RequestErrorRate rule was not identified: list_prometheus_rules with rule_name=RequestErrorRate returned no rules, and get_all_labels for http_server_request_duration_seconds_count returned no series in the window; frontend impact is therefore evidenced from traces_span_metrics_calls_total error spans, not from the alert's own expression.

An instant query for kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready / kube_deployment_status_replicas_available on namespace otel-demo, deployment product-catalog returned no series, so the deployment's readiness is evidenced only from the Kubernetes API object status (unavailableReplicas 1, Available=False), not from kube-state-metrics.

fraud-detection's OOMKilled container restart (exit 137, restartCount 1) has no observable timestamp in the evidence, so whether it falls inside the incident window and whether it affected any request could not be determined; its error-span counts are 0 but its latency was not examined.
next_steps: Have the platform owner inspect the Helm values/manifest source for deployment otel-demo/product-catalog (revision 2) and remove the container command ["invalid-command"], then roll back to the revision-1 template and watch the rollout to a ready pod with 0 restarts.

After the revert, verify that the product-catalog Endpoints object lists a pod IP, that traces_span_metrics_calls_total for service_name=product-catalog resumes (~10/s baseline), and that frontend error-span share returns to ~0 %.
Correlate the change record for 2026-11-15T13:48:34Z from the change-history system (not integrated here) to identify the actor and confirm the invalid command was the only change in revision 2.

Check whether the RequestErrorRate alert rule's own metric series exists at all (the rule name and the http_server_request_duration_seconds_count series were not found), so the alert's threshold and expression can be validated against the observed trace-based error rate.
